pkgmetadata.longdescription: Grok Bot is xAI's desktop client for its "always-on" AI agents, built by Anysphere (the makers of Cursor) on Electron. Each bot runs against its own cloud computer and can keep working in the background. Repackaged here from the upstream Debian/Ubuntu .deb, since no source build is offered; the application is proprietary and needs an eligible paid Cursor/SuperGrok account to sign in.

use.flag: Install chrome-sandbox setuid root (upstream's own Debian package default), so Chromium's sandbox still works when unprivileged user namespaces are unavailable. Disabled by default, since most Gentoo kernels enable unprivileged userns and that alone is normally enough; enable this flag if the sandbox reports it cannot start.
